From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Subject: ChronoBank — security evidence sprint proposal & next steps

Thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap so we’re all aligned and a proposed next-steps plan to get ChronoBank the artifacts you asked for.

Key pain points we heard
- Regulatory audit window: internal auditors expect evidence in ~8 weeks.
- Audit log access: need an exportable, time-rangeable audit log for admin and data-access events.
- Retention policy: how long logs and artifacts are retained and how redaction/PII handling is surfaced.
- Pen test/third-party validation: need recent testing evidence + remediation notes.

Objectives (what success looks like)
- Provide SOC 2 Type II report or equivalent summary under NDA.
- Deliver an evidence bundle (controls mapping + artifacts) that can be ingested by your auditors.
- Provide a short walkthrough/demo showing how to pull audit logs and retention settings.
- Share a DPA draft and accept an initial round of redlines.

Proposed evidence sprint (owners & timeline)
1) Today (Vanessa / Redwood): send SOC 2 summary + evidence intake template (attached).
2) By Tue 5/18 (ChronoBank): assign a single security/controls owner and procurement contact we can loop legal into.
3) Wed 5/19–Fri 5/21 (Redwood + ChronoBank): intake & evidence handoff window — we’ll surface the most relevant artifacts first (identity, access, change management, logging).
4) Week of 5/24: joint review call to walk through audit log export and any DPA redlines.

Attachments in this email
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary of scope & control families)
- evidence-intake-template.csv (CSV mapping of requested artifacts to Redwood owners)
- redwood-dpa-draft-chronobank.docx (initial DPA draft for legal)

As discussed, the minimum items you said you needed for initial audit sign-off: SOC 2 summary, admin access logs for the last 12 months (or since deployment), retention policy statement, and any pen test report within the last 12 months with remediation notes.

Please confirm: 1) primary ChronoBank security contact for evidence intake, 2) preferred NDA route (we can share SOC2 after NDA), and 3) availability for a 45-minute joint review on Thurs 5/20 afternoon or Mon 5/24 morning.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly so your auditors have what they need.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: ChronoBank — security evidence sprint proposal & next steps

Vanessa — thanks for the clear recap and the docs. A few clarifications from our side after internal alignment this afternoon: 

- Retention: as a regulated financial services firm we typically require a 7-year retention baseline for transaction-related logs; for admin/audit logs we can accept 3 years with justification. Can you send your formal retention statements for both?
- SOC 2: we’ll need a Type II report; NDA route is preferable — procurement/legal will push the NDA through DocuSign.
- Pen test: we accept third-party reports up to 12 months old; anything older will require a short remediation note.
- Audit log export: it’s critical for us that exports include user IDs, timestamps (UTC), action codes, and object identifiers. If you can include a one-page sample export schema that would help our auditors.

Our internal owner for this intake is Tom Becker (CC’d). Procurement will be procurement@chronobank.com. Please loop them into the DPA thread and route the DocuSign link to procurement.

We can commit to the proposed sprint window, but please note our auditors want all evidence packaged by 5/31 to meet their review schedule. If Redwood can prioritize identity & logging artifacts first, that would be ideal.

Thanks — I’ll wait for the SOC 2 under NDA and the sample export schema.

—
Claire Dawson
Head of Information Risk
ChronoBank
claire@chronobank.com | +1 (212) 555-9843

We’ll keep the package prioritized: identity & logging artifacts first, then change-management and vulnerability/pen-test artifacts.
